sources.license_note: U.S. National Library of Medicine E-utilities. No API key. Low-volume public use; send tool and email when a contact is configured.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text as a quoted phrase, retmax, db=pubmed, optional tool and email. No user profile.

sources.license_note: PMC full-text corpus metadata via the same public E-utilities host. No API key.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text as a quoted phrase, retmax, db=pmc, optional tool and email. No user profile.

sources.license_note: Europe PMC Articles REST API. No API key. Abstracts are retrieved under Europe PMC terms.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text as a quoted phrase, pageSize, format=json, resultType=core. No user profile.

sources.license_note: Crossref public REST API, polite pool via User-Agent when a contact is configured. Metadata may be CC0; abstracts follow the publisher license on each work.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text in query.bibliographic, rows. User-Agent identifies this fabric. No user profile.

sources.license_note: DOAJ public article search API. No API key. Records are open-access journal articles; DOAJ does not assert retraction state.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text as a single path segment, pageSize. No user profile.

sources.license_note: arXiv public Atom API. No API key. Records are preprints. Withdrawal is read only from explicit arXiv withdrawal text.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text in search_query=all:, max_results. No user profile.

sources.license_note: OpenAlex public works API. No API key. Qualified because it is an aggregated open catalog, not a primary publisher or MEDLINE record. mailto is sent only when a contact is configured.
sources.sends: Scholarly query text in search, per-page, optional mailto. No user profile.

sources.license_note: NCBI ID Converter maps DOI, PMID, and PMCID. It is not a search index. No API key. Live check 2026-09-29: the former www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/utils/idconv/v1.0/ URL returns HTTPS 301 to pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/tools/idconv/api/v1/articles/. The allowlist follows that permanent contract move.
sources.sends: Already-normalized DOI, PMID, or PMCID values only. The original query text is not sent again.

sources.license_note: Not consulted. Unauthenticated behavior and key requirements are not a stable INR 0 contract for this lane.
